about: Deep Space Network antennas with their published receive horizon masks (810-005 module 301 Rev. O). Other networks' stations are not listed yet: their masks are not published, so any added later carry an assumed flat limit, labelled.

records.name: DSS-14 (70-meter)

sources.title: DSN Telecommunications Link Design Handbook 810-005, module 301 Rev. O, Coverage and Geometry (Table 5, geodetic coordinates)
DSN 810-005 module 301 Rev. O horizon mask download spreadsheet (masks effective 1 May 2024)

notes: Goldstone, California (GDSCC). Receive mask: the lowest elevation the antenna can track at each degree of azimuth (terrain, neighbouring antennas, or the mechanical limit).
